routing.reason: This task hardens Chat execution reliability only; no visual production, Figma mutation, browser production workflow, or local runtime is required.

trigger_learning.lesson: Git task creation, project page creation, filled editor, or attempted send do not prove actual Chat execution.
A confirmed-start conversation can later become unreadable; blind Retry or rerun can duplicate creative work.

objective: Bind two fail-closed execution reliability gates into the shenmei canonical entrypoint: positive Chat dispatch confirmation before claiming start, and unreadable-conversation recovery before any rerun. The gates must prevent duplicate visual generation and preserve the six existing content/aesthetic/business routes unchanged.

pass_requires_all: post-send browser URL is a current-project conversation URL containing /c/
post-send active processing/response state is positively observed
insufficient_evidence: Enter/send action was attempted without post-send confirmation

unreadable_triggers: 无法加载此 ChatGPT 对话
hard_rules: STOP interaction with the unreadable execution Chat.
Do not infer visual/creative completion or failure from unreadable UI alone.
Before any rerun, inspect the task's declared durable outputs and current repository/task authority.
If durable output exists, recover/validate it; do not rerun.
If durable output does not exist, explicitly block the old execution before fresh recovery.
Fresh recovery is allowed only when frozen task scope is unchanged and a new Chat passes CHAT_DISPATCH_CONFIRMATION.
If authority changes before fresh recovery dispatch, STOP_REBASE_REQUIRED.

visual_safety_binding.purpose: Prevent duplicate image/Figma/brand-case production after UI uncertainty.
future_visual_tasks_must_declare: expected durable output identity/path/manifest when applicable
duplicate_prevention: Unreadable UI alone never authorizes another image generation.
A missing Chat view is not evidence that generation did not happen.
Before visual rerun, check declared durable output/asset state first.
Fresh recovery cannot silently increase generation_count, reroll count, best-of-N, or hidden variants.

required_changes: Add a highest-priority execution-reliability section to START_HERE.md without changing any of the six content-route semantics.
Create one reusable reliability contract covering dispatch confirmation and unreadable-conversation recovery.

regression_cases.case: task record exists + project page open + prompt filled but URL remains /project and no processing state
visual Chat unreadable + durable output exists
visual Chat unreadable + no durable output + old task not blocked
old task blocked + scope unchanged + no durable output

success_condition: Shenmei can no longer report Chat execution as started without /c/ + processing evidence, and cannot rerun an unreadable visual execution without durable-output readback, old-task blocking, unchanged scope, and confirmed fresh dispatch; all six content routes remain byte/semantically unchanged.

pass_requires: post-send URL is a project /c/... conversation
